name: nuee
description: Nuee is an npm-workspaces TypeScript monorepo pairing a React 19 + Vite SPA frontend with a synchronous NestJS modular monolith backend on SQLite, sharing serialized API contracts and validation limits through a dependency-free @nuee/shared-types package. It centers on a spatial canvas of knowledge bubbles with AI-assisted discussions, document processing, and knowledge extraction. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.
